name: codeonym-oss
description: Design skills for Claude Code with a reproducible, headless toolchain: graphic design, illustration, photo editing, UI design, typography, print layout, 3D with Blender, video editing and screen recording. Every script runs in a versioned container (Blender, GIMP, Inkscape, Krita, Scribus, darktable, ffmpeg, ImageMagick, fonts…) so it works the same on Linux, macOS and Windows (WSL2).
